content.text: I fixed an off-by-one in `solution/core.py`, and the visible suite now passes (3 tests). `parse_range` built each range with `range(a, b)`, which leaves out the upper bound, so `"1-3"` gave `[1, 2]`. I changed it to `range(a, b + 1)`, which makes the end inclusive. I didn't touch anything under `tests/`.
